projects.title: SERENITI
projects.description: The project aims to develop novel methodologies for the design of security- and resilience-aware ICT infrastructures for networked critical infrastructures, such as water plants, oil and gas pipelines, the power grid, and the emerging Smart Grid.

projects.title: Brain Tumor Detection and Segmentation in MR Images Using Machine Learning
projects.description: This project aims to develop machine learning methods for brain tumor segmentation in MR images.

projects.title: Data traffic control in wireless networks for moving agents
projects.description: Development and testing of control algorithms and real-time communication protocols that can be applied to networked control systems.

projects.title: Ericsson BME 5G
projects.description: We used two Universal Robots arms (UR3 and UR3e) to perform a pick-and-place assembly task. To simulate factory conditions, a conveyor fed ArUco-encoded pieces to the robotic setup. When a desired piece was detected, we estimated an ideal pickup position from which it could be lifted off the conveyor. Once both arms held a correct piece, the assembly was performed — a motion that required a synchronized set of movements from the robotic arms.

projects.title: TO - Teleoperation
projects.description: The main goal of the project is to develop control algorithms, trajectory generation algorithms, and real-time communication protocols that can be applied to robotic systems operating in hazardous environments, supervised by a human operator through video feedback.
